body.message:
We have coordinated with the team member, and as previously confirmed, if you choose Unit 406, there will be a price difference. The updated rate is AED 5,500 for 1 month.

You have already paid AED 5,000, so the remaining balance is AED 500.

Kindly note that the security deposit is AED 2,000; however, we can adjust it for you to AED 1,000 only.

We kindly request your assistance to complete the pending payment so we can proceed with handing over the apartment.

Thank you.
